title: Hearty Rich Tunisian Bread Tagine
description: A resinous and creamy one-pot Tunisian dish featuring bread, perfect for a low-carb friendly meal option.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 300 degrees Fahrenheit.
Cut the bread into 1-inch cubes and toast until lightly browned.
Heat the olive oil in a large Dutch oven over medium heat.
Add the onion and garlic and cook until the onion is translucent.
Add the ground beef and cook until browned, breaking it up into small pieces.
Stir in the cumin and paprika and cook for 1 minute.
Add the toasted bread and chicken broth to the pot and bring to a boil.
Cover the pot and transfer to the preheated oven.
Bake for 25 minutes or until the bread is tender and the liquid has been absorbed.
